column3: “Fortress” is rendered “the fortified city,” and the line division differs: “the remnant of Aram” is joined to Damascus.
“Beating” is rendered “shaking,” and “fruit-bearing” as “a fruitful tree.”
“Cities of refuge” is rendered “strong cities,” and “the tree-top” as “branches”; NASB supplies “the land.”
“The vine branch of a stranger” is rendered “vine slips of a strange god.”
“You cause to grow” is rendered “you carefully fence it in”; the meaning is uncertain.
